note: args.grid: point i (0 to nu * nv - 1) has column i % nu and row i // nu, U = u0 + column * du, V = v0 + row * dv. The albedo of point i is ((mul[c] * i + add[c]) % 256) as float64 (args.alb). args.dither true: dither[i] = reelkit.config.BAYER[row % 4, column % 4]; false: None. The result: "changed" lists the points whose albedo differs from the input, "out" their rows (k, 3); every other row is the input. expect.returned is "alb" when Python returned the array it was given (no mark alive).
